t: This is openDemocracy, an independent media platform and news website based in the United Kingdom. It was founded in 2001, and says it seeks to challenge power and encourage democratic debate around the world through its reporting and analysis of social and political issues. It has been funded by grants from several foundations, and by donations from readers. Its founders include Anthony Barnett, a writer and campaigner, and Paul Hilder, a social entrepreneur and writer who has also stood for positions in the Labour Party.
